nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the privileged caller check in ensure, delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested allowance mapping; written in approve and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private whitelist mapping consulted by ensure to bypass sale conditions.
Private mapping counting how many sale transfers an address has performed; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private minimum sale amount, configured in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, configured in init and enforced in condition.
Private per-address sale count limit, configured in init and enforced in condition.
Privileged address whitelisted in ensure and set through setTradeAddress.
Public total supply, fixed at construction from _supply.
Constant public decimals value (18) used as the scaling exponent in init and constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate used by transferFrom; returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/whitelisted senders, otherwise delegates to condition. Computes _UNI via pairFor.
Public payable transfer core; checks/updates allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally.
Internal view sale-limit policy check reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address a with data b; full contract takeover primitive.
Owner-only initializer writing _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum from caller-supplied values.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos, computing total = _value * _tos.length and mutating balanceOf with unchecked math.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using create2-style hashing.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balanceOf and an infinite allowance to the UNI router.
External caller identity used for owner checks, allowance bookkeeping and balance mutations across the contract.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate: executes arbitrary bytecode in the contract's storage context.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; multiplication without SafeMath can overflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom; unchecked addition.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom; unchecked subtraction.

edges.reason: transfer forwards the caller msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transfer delegates all execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom branches on msg.sender != _from to require and decrement allowance.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate gates the arbitrary delegatecall behind require(msg.sender == owner).
init gates the sale-configuration writes behind require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend gates the mass balance write behind require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress gates the privileged whitelist write behind require(msg.sender == owner).
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the total supply to it.
delegate executes the owner-supplied target via delegatecall, giving storage-level control of the token.
The user-supplied bytes b flows directly into the delegatecall calldata.
batchSend computes total from _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
The local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked balance subtraction.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom calls ensure() to authorize the transfer.
ensure falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure reads the owner state variable to whitelist the sender/recipient.
ensure reads tradeAddress to whitelist the sender.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to whitelist the sender.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
The local _UNI is used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
condition reads _saleNum for the per-address sale limit.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
init writes _minSale derived from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale derived from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
Constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
batchSend deducts from and credits balanceOf entries.
